author: CC
prose: The orchestrator, 2026-11-16: "cast the commons pre-merge-commit sibling (cairn/tools/artifact/hooks) as the next ticket." A1 (db250e9bf3f9) makes a merge into cairn run the tester's commit door. The commons' hook is the artifact tool's, and the commons has no pre-merge-commit either, so every commons land skips the artifact check.
